summary: Locks a 3D sub-region (lock box) of a Direct3D surface and copies the resulting surface information into the a2 descriptor. Releases any existing interface stored at *this, queries the surface description via vtable slot +32, validates and block-aligns a supplied 3D rect (format-dependent rounding), queries render-state capability support via vtable slot +28 around sub_500EAC toggles, calls vtable slot +36 (LockBox) with mode flags, fills the descriptor (pitch, FourCC, dimensions, depth, rect copy, a6, a4), and stores the surface pointer a3 at *this.

local_names.v18: surface format FourCC from the vtable+32 query
local_names.v30: flag indicating whether a rect conversion is needed

operations.description: If *this is non-null, release the stored COM interface via VTableReleaseClear before the new surface pointer is stored.
Query the surface description from a3's vtable slot +32 into v18; the FourCC at v18 drives later rect-alignment decisions.
When a5 (requested rect) is provided, validate the 6-dword rect against surface size: reject with error -2005530516 if x2>width, x0>x2, y2>height, y1>y2, z2>depth or z0>z2.
Determine whether a rect conversion is needed: when a5 is null, build a full-surface rect from v21/v22/v23, clear the conversion flag and set v9 from the a7 bit 0 test.
Reject with error -2005530516 when the render capability flag v20 is clear and the capability word v19 lacks bit 0x200.
Compute the lock mode flags from a7: base v11 = 16 * ((a7 & 1) | 0x80); optionally OR 0x2000 when a7 has bit 0x20000 set or the capability query reports support.
Toggle rendering state via sub_500EAC(1) then sub_500EAC(0) around a capability query on a3 vtable slot +28 using unk_5AD4B0.

Round the requested rect to the format block size according to the FourCC at v18: 2-pixel x/y alignment for the 844715353 and 1498831189 paths, 4-pixel x/y alignment for 827611204 / 844388420 / 861165636 / 877942852 / 894720068; clamp to surface bounds.
Call a3 vtable slot +36 (LockBox) with the aligned rect and computed flags; propagate a negative HRESULT result.
Fill the a2 descriptor: pitch/pointers from v26, FourCC v18, width/height from v26, depth v23, a 0x18-byte copy of the rect, a6, a4, set a2[16]=1, and store the surface pointer a3 at *this.
Return 0 on success, otherwise the HRESULT returned by the LockBox call.

clean_pseudocode: copy 6-dword rect from a5; validate x/y/z bounds else return E_FAIL;
else { sub_500EAC(1); query vtable+28 with unk_5AD4B0; if supported flags |= 0x2000; sub_500EAC(0); }
align rect to format block size; clamp to surface;
